pattern.Regex:
(?x)
    # Multi-char operators (longest match first)
    <=>|<<=|>>=|->\*|\.\*|
    ::|->|==|!=|<=|>=|&&|\|\||<<|>>|\+\+|--|
    \+=|-=|\*=|/=|%=|&=|\|=|\^=|
    \.\.\.|\#\#|//|/\*|\*/|
    # Diff markers
    \@\@|---|\+\+\+|
    # Morpheme boundary marker (must not be merged across)
    \x00|
    # Newlines (structural whitespace)
    \n\n|\n|
    # Single-char punctuation (each is its own token)
    [{}()\[\]<>;:,.\+\-\*/%&\|^~!?=\#@\$_\\\"'`]
